Results.ReviewText: I have quite a lot of smokers and grills, so I believe I know about grills. Overall the grill itself works flawlessly. However, I think Weber should/could improve it without adding much in the way of costs. First, kudos to Weber for adding extra hardware because I needed it. Was short 2 screws. Only had one extra which I needed, the other I figured out a way to not need/use it. The grill gets hot quickly, but also does a great job of staying at 300-350 indirect heat too. Things Weber should improve: folding shelves. Making the shelves foldable would add probably all of 50 cents more to manufacture but would be a huge benefit. On my back patio I have a Workhorse Pits, a TMG smoker, Assassin cabinet smoker, Lone Star Grillz smoker, an Assassin charcoal grill, OK Joe Bronco, Blackstone griddle, Halo Pizza Oven, and an outdoor fryer, so moving things around to get this to fit was a challenge. Next issue is the igniter. This grill uses only one igniter on the left burner and the other burners light off of that burner. So if you want the middle burner on, you have to turn the left and middle burner on then turn the left burner off instead of just adding an igniter on all 3 burners. The last thing I’d like to see Weber add is a sacrificial piece of metal on the hood similar to the genesis. This grill does get hot and having that piece of metal would help maintain the enamel on the herd better. Otherwise, I could see the heat potentially affecting the enamel. Other than that, I’m glad to see Weber offer a more affordable grill than the Genesis or Summit but still make it feel premium when compared to most other brands. However, for the price, those 3 changes should be included.  Knowing that before purchasing, I still thought that this was the best grill for my needs. I would buy again.

Results.ReviewText:
Purchased the grill for fathers day. Assembly was easy enough. Looked like a great cooking surface. However, when preheating the grill several times it would always give a strong burning plastic smell. I've read its common for new grills to have an offgas smell as sometimes packaging leaves residues, so cleaned the grill and preheated several more times. Still a bad burning plastic smell. 

Noticed there are several components that are plastic: the trim on the knob control panel, the washers on the frame, and the lid handle. All of which heat up and release burning plastic smells.

Returned without actually cooking on it. Debated whether I should leave a negative review but would have loved if someone had pointed out the plastic components before purchasing.
Results.Title: Great grill/bad plastic smell

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
